title.en: What building window does Electric Low Pressure 60 print?
title.zh: 电动低压60给建筑浇筑印了哪一扇窗口？

description.en: Electric Low Pressure 60, also marked Electric 75-60, prints 75 kW, 35 m³/h, 30 MPa, fine stone 150 m / 350 m, 13 mm 100 m / 300 m and 24 mm 80 m / 240 m.
description.zh: 电动低压60，页上亦标 Electric 75-60：75 kW、35 m³/h、30 MPa，细石 150 m / 350 m，13 mm 100 m / 300 m，24 mm 80 m / 240 m。

h1.en: What building window does Electric Low Pressure 60 print?
h1.zh: 电动低压60给建筑浇筑印了哪一扇窗口？

directAnswer.en: A grid-powered building line that matches one of three stone rows. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists Electric Low Pressure 60 / Electric 75-60 at 75 kW, 35 m³/h, 30 MPa and hopper 0.5 m³. Fine stone is 150 m / 350 m. 13 mm stone is 100 m / 300 m. 24 mm stone is 80 m / 240 m. Weight is 3500 kg. The scenario text is building and commercial placement.
directAnswer.zh: 对得上三行石子之一的有电网建筑管路。邢台河北品锦机械把电动低压60 / Electric 75-60 列为 75 kW、35 m³/h、30 MPa、料斗 0.5 m³。细石 150 m / 350 m。13 mm 石子 100 m / 300 m。24 mm 石子 80 m / 240 m。重量 3500 kg。工况原文是建筑与商业浇筑。

heading.en: Do not swap it with Electric 60

body.en: Electric 60 is the high-rise electric row: 90 kW, 40 m³/h, 35 MPa, fine stone 200 m / 600 m, 13 mm 150 m / 450 m, 24 mm 100 m / 300 m, weight 3300 kg. The low-pressure 60 is 75 kW and 35 m³/h with the shorter distances above. The shared “60” does not merge the tables.
body.zh: 电动60是高层电动行：90 kW、40 m³/h、35 MPa，细石 200 m / 600 m，13 mm 150 m / 450 m，24 mm 100 m / 300 m，重量 3300 kg。低压60是 75 kW、35 m³/h，距离是上面较短的那一组。都叫“60”，表不能合并。

heading.en: What the frame tells you about access
heading.zh: 机架说明进场时要核对什么

body.en: The printed size is 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm and 3500 kg, with a Kawasaki double pump 100. That is a trailer pump for a building pipeline, not a compact 450 kg rural unit and not a spraying machine. If the site cannot feed 75 kW, open a diesel building-or-infrastructure row instead of keeping this name.
body.zh: 已印外形是 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm、3500 kg，液压泵为川崎双泵 100。这是建筑管路用的拖泵，不是 450 kg 的农村紧凑机，也不是喷涂机。现场供不上 75 kW，就改开柴油的建筑或基建行，不要留在这个名字上。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Quote the stone row and confirm a supply for 75 kW. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请引用石子行，并确认能否供应 75 kW。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

answer.en: It is the model cell printed beside Electric Low Pressure 60. It is not a second unpublished machine on this page.
answer.zh: 它是电动低压60旁边印出的型号格。不是这一页上另一台未公布的机器。

answer.en: No. Fine stone is horizontal 150 m / vertical 350 m.
answer.zh: 不是。细石是水平 150 m / 垂直 350 m。

question.en: Is 35 m³/h a deck or floor volume?
question.zh: 35 m³/h 是某层楼的方量吗？

answer.en: No. It is theoretical output. This page names no floor and no contract volume.
answer.zh: 不是。它是理论输送量。本页不写楼层，也不写合同方量。
